items.quote: Several respondents noted that Torko Thalira contributed effectively to public communications on the new scheme.
Direct reports said that Torko was recognised sector-wide for her leadership of bilateral negotiations on the water agreement.
Direct reports said that Torko drove efforts to keep unions, grassroots leaders and trade associations on side for the whole division.
She spearheaded the use of survey numbers to decide where to put new clinics at the national level.
She drove steadying a team facing adversity for the whole division.
Several respondents noted that Torko delivered her share of trialling a fresh approach to permit queues reliably.
She handled root cause analysis of recurring service failures competently within her team.
Direct reports said that Torko took ownership of the shift to a new way of working after two branches were combined and steered it to completion.
Direct reports said that Torko championed the scenario planning exercise on future workforce needs and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Peers observed that Torko Thalira led the partnership with sister agencies on youth services across the department.
Torko championed upholding governance and audit standards and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Peers observed that Torko Thalira took ownership of process improvement in licensing operations and steered it to completion.
